research: Per-article sources (with authors, dates, scores and context) are listed in each article's Sources section. Research fact sheets were compiled 2026-10-24 from the cited URLs.
caveats: Tenchu: exact US street date disputed (31 Aug 1998 per GameSpot/Metacritic vs. 'in stores by 9/16' per IGN). Existence of a level editor on the US disc unverified. Rev 1 vs original pressing differences undocumented. Mechanics came from the PAL English manual, not the US manual. EGM individual scores and Next Generation star ratings only via Wikipedia.

MGS3 Subsistence: GameSpot review's original publication date uncertain (page shows 2007). JP and EU MGO shutdown dates from Wikipedia only. Foxhound rank thresholds fan-derived. Whether Android PS2 emulators offer a pressure-modifier binding was not checked; the full-pressure consequence is labelled inference.

Deception III: no confirmed PAL release (HG101 claim unsupported by serial). Japanese title is Somato, not Kagero II (that is Trapt). Game Informer 'Deception III Undergoes Change' news item not found, so localisation changes unknown. EGM individual scores only via Wikipedia. No chapter-length data.

Shinobido: OPS2 UK, Edge and Famitsu scores only second-hand. No English manual scan found; faction/trust terminology from fan FAQs and Japanese sources. Takumi release date conflicts. PAL-only kill/combo changes come from one fan FAQ.

Revision 2 (public edition): personal-library, device and travel framing removed; prose reworked for a general audience; article game references added. Research facts unchanged. Shinobido box and Tenchu box provenance restated as their public origin (ScreenScraper via ES-DE; libretro-thumbnails).
